title: The 'Mexican walking fish' box
storyboard: Film: friend opens a box labelled 'Mexican walking fish'; inside is a printed axolotl photo and a fact card

scenes.headline: Gave my friend a box labelled 'Mexican walking fish'
Plot twist #1: it's not a fish. It's a salamander.
Plot twist #2: it never really grows up
scenes.body: Axolotls keep their feathery gills and stay aquatic as adults, a trait called neoteny.

scenes.headline: Critically Endangered in the wild
scenes.body: Wild axolotls survive only in the Xochimilco canals near Mexico City. The box held a printed photo, not an animal.

caption:
The name is the real prank.

Axolotls are famous in science for regrowing lost limbs, which makes them a major subject of regeneration research.

Source: National Geographic (Axolotl).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Prank on the name, not on an animal: friend opens a box holding a printed photo and fact card. Explicitly discourages buying axolotls as prank pets.
